plugins.name: relay
plugins.description: Two agent handoff system for passing batch work.

commands.name: relay-check
commands.description: Check relay_state.md after a completion and fire relay-out if the threshold is reached. Called by any relay-compatible command after each atomic unit completes, only when --relay is active.

commands.name: relay-halt
commands.description: Explicitly stop the workflow. All progress is saved first. Pause always precedes halt.
headings: Step 4 — Write relay.md with status: halted

commands.name: relay-in
commands.description: Wake up and continue work after the polling watcher fires, or resume manually after a pause.

commands.name: relay-out
commands.description: Save all progress and hand off to the Sleeper agent. Writing relay.md with `status: ready` wakes the Sleeper's polling watcher. **relay.md is always written last.**
headings: Step 1 — Confirm you are at a save point
Step 2 — Write completed work to final locations
Step 5 — Verify a Sleeper is parked
Step 6 — Write relay.md with status: ready (LAST)
Step 7 — Stop and prompt the user

commands.name: relay-pause
commands.description: Save all progress and stop without handing off. Resume later with /relay-in.
headings: Step 1 — Confirm you are at a save point
Step 2 — Write completed work to final locations
Step 5 — Write relay.md with status: paused (LAST)

commands.name: relay-standby
commands.description: Park this agent as the Sleeper. Waits for Worker to signal, then picks up automatically.

commands.name: relay-test
commands.description: Self-contained relay handoff test. Runs a synthetic 4-item batch (Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta) with no queue dependencies and no lasting artifacts. Supports --relay flag like any other batch command.

headings: Setting Up in a New Project
Step 3 — Add the Relay Contract to your CLAUDE.md
Sleeper arrives after relay-out was blocked
